section.title: Change preview
section.label: Preview changes before applying
section.hint: Saving in the editor, applying in “Create resource”, and Helm upgrades and installs first show what the API server would store (a server-side dry run). The change is sent only when you confirm it.
section.defaultOn: The name of this cluster contains “prod” or “production”, so the preview is on by default.
section.defaultOff: The preview is on by default only for clusters whose name contains “prod” or “production”.

actions.required: This cluster asks for a preview before applying.
actions.blocked: Fix the refused documents before applying.

diff.title: Change preview
diff.created: {{object}} does not exist yet: it would be created.
diff.unchanged: The API server would store {{object}} as it is.
diff.refused_one: The API server would refuse {{count}} object. Fix the text before applying: an apply stops at the first refused document, after applying the ones before it.
diff.refused_other: The API server would refuse {{count}} objects. Fix the text before applying: an apply stops at the first refused document, after applying the ones before it.
diff.waitsForNamespace: {{object}} could not be checked yet: its namespace {{namespace}} is created by an earlier document. Applying creates the namespace first.

helm.noRelease: There is no release with this name yet: every object is new.
helm.same: The rendered manifest is the same as the release's.
helm.unreadable_one: {{count}} document could not be read and is not shown.
helm.unreadable_other: {{count}} documents could not be read and are not shown.
helm.clientSide: This Helm cannot render against the cluster (it is older than 3.13): lookups found nothing, so Secrets and other values a chart reuses may show as changed.
helm.noHooks: Helm hooks are not part of the comparison.
